title: The Clock Illusion Everyone Falls For (Test Yourself)
description:
Stare at the dot, snap your eyes to the clock, and the first tick seems to last longer. Your brain is quietly editing time, and this is how it does it.

SOURCES:
- Yarrow, K., Haggard, P., Heal, R., Brown, P., & Rothwell, J. C. (2001). Illusory perceptions of space and time preserve cross-saccadic perceptual continuity. Nature, 414(6861), 302-305. doi:10.1038/35104551
- Ross, J., Morrone, M. C., Goldberg, M. E., & Burr, D. C. (2001). Changes in visual perception at the time of saccades. Trends in Neurosciences, 24(2), 113-121.
